title: 8. Insight to concept promotion with lineage (M)
description:
Shipped story: ship-0be231 (promote an insight to a concept). Size M. Depends on stories 4 and 7.

As an editor, I want to promote an insight to a concept with its lineage recorded, so that the map shows where concepts came from.

Acceptance criteria:
- Promotion goes through a new-concept Proposal (story 4).
- The concept records lineage: 'born DATE from story X, drew on clusters A, B'.
- Lineage is publicly readable and included in the snapshot.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
